summary: Tested TNS Creations auth (email/password + Emergent Google) and admin leads dashboard end-to-end. 7/7 backend pytest cases pass. 15/15 frontend Playwright checks pass, including cookie-injected non-admin Google user seeing the Access pending screen. Login attempts collection cleared after tests so seeded admin is not locked out.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: CORSMiddleware uses allow_credentials=True with CORS_ORIGINS='*' (backend/.env). Browsers reject credentialed CORS with wildcard origin. It currently works because frontend uses same-origin relative /api paths via Vite proxy, but if any cross-origin caller is added this will break. Recommend setting CORS_ORIGINS to explicit origin(s).

server.py: app.add_middleware(CORSMiddleware, ...) is added AFTER app.include_router(...). Starlette applies middleware in reverse insertion order and this ordering still works, but it's more idiomatic (and safer for exception handling) to register CORS before including routers.
auth.py logout: response.delete_cookie(..., secure=True, samesite='none') — httpOnly flag not re-set on delete. Minor; browsers still clear the cookie by name+path.

routers/auth.py login: on successful password verification, calls upsert_user() which re-computes role from ADMIN_EMAILS. If a seeded admin email is later removed from ADMIN_EMAIL/ADMIN_EMAILS env, the admin flag gets demoted on next login. Documented behavior but worth noting.

Google session exchange creates a session using the token returned by Emergent (data.get('session_token')) but sets it on same 'session_token' cookie. Fine, but if Emergent token format collides with local secrets.token_urlsafe(48) it doesn't matter — just consistency.
No rate limiting on /api/leads POST (public endpoint). Consider adding basic per-IP throttling to avoid spam.

seed_data_creation: Temporarily inserted one non-admin user + session in mongo to test /admin Access-pending screen; cleaned up. login_attempts collection cleared to prevent lockout of seeded admin.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests live at /app/backend/tests/test_auth_and_leads.py — autouse fixture wipes login_attempts around each test. Frontend uses relative /api via Vite proxy; public URL https://growth-agency-74.preview.emergentagent.com. For non-admin Google user simulation via browser, inject cookie session_token (httpOnly, secure, sameSite None) after inserting user+session per /app/auth_testing.md. Google button correctly navigates to https://auth.emergentagent.com (auto-redirects to /oauth/) with redirect=<origin>/admin.
test_flows_executed: POST /auth/login success sets cookie; /auth/me + /leads via cookie; POST /auth/logout invalidates session (401 on next /me).

Frontend: /admin unauthenticated → /login; email validation errors; password required error; wrong password shows login-server-error; Google button navigates to auth.emergentagent.com with correct redirect; admin login shows dashboard with filter/count cards and refresh; logout returns to /login and re-guards /admin; homepage header-free-trial-button opens lead-modal-form; footer-admin-login-link points to /login; non-admin Google user via cookie injection sees admin-no-access 'Access pending'.
